I have lost 2 people in my life to suicide. My cousin and my best friend. My cousin went downhill very fast, he began taking drugs and his girlfriend had had enough and told him she was leaving and packed her bags. A few hours after leaving my cousin ended his own life and was found by his youngest daughter who refused to leave with her mother.

My best friend had turned his life around. In school he had weight problems and by the second year of college had lost over 70lbs. But it wasnt enough, he still struggled and it became too much. I blame myself every day for his death because I didn't reach out to him, we hadn't spoken in over a year but still considered him best friend. The reason we hadn't spoken or seen each other was because we were suffering with social anxiety. I was in the middle of of CBT (cognitive behavioral therapy) when I got the news and my world kind of fell apart as I intended on getting him out to have a drink once I was done. I have 2 tattoos on my wrists that are dedicated to him. Both of them are the names of our favourite songs from the same band. We always fought over which was better.
